title: Hydra project configuration
description: Shared, versioned configuration for a Hydra project. Hydra runtime validation remains authoritative.

$schema.description: JSON Schema used by editors for validation, completion, and field documentation. Hydra does not download it at runtime.

version.description: Hydra project-configuration format. Version 2 is the only supported version.

projectId.description: Opaque project identity generated by hydra init. Keep it unchanged and shared through Git.

headsDirectory.description: Portable policy used to resolve the physical directory that contains this project's Heads.

branchPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every private Head branch name, for example hydra/.

storage.description: Storage selection policy. Auto safely chooses copy-on-write when available and otherwise uses a full copy.

overlay.description: Rules selecting ignored project files that should be materialized inside each Head.

commands.description: Optional trusted command adapters executed by explicit Hydra lifecycle commands.

siblingHeadsDirectory.title: Sibling Heads directory
siblingHeadsDirectory.description: Places the Heads directory beside the repository by appending a filename suffix.

suffix.description: Non-empty filename suffix without path separators or control characters.

relativeHeadsDirectory.title: Relative Heads directory
relativeHeadsDirectory.description: Resolves a portable path from the repository parent directory.

base.description: Anchor used to resolve the relative path.

path.description: Portable relative path containing only normal, non-empty components.

localHeadsDirectory.title: Local Heads directory
localHeadsDirectory.description: Uses only the verified absolute Heads path from local, non-versioned Hydra metadata.

mode.description: Selects copy-on-write when safely supported and an isolated full copy otherwise.

copy.description: Ordered Gitignore-style rules. The directive ... .gitignore expands the project's current .gitignore at this position.

open.description: Trusted program adapter run by hydra head open after Head validation.

program.description: Executable to start without a shell. Supported placeholders: {name}, {path}, {headRef}, {baseRef}, and {targetRef}.

args.description: Arguments passed separately to the executable. Each value may use the supported placeholders.
